Consent to movement summaries is separate from camera permission. Withdrawal stops new collection; earlier records remain until a reviewed deletion request is completed.

Requests are recorded for administrator review. A deletion request does not silently delete data or backups. Development records have no automatic purge; retention must be configured before deployment.

YYYY-MM-DD. Age is calculated automatically from your birthdate.

Motivance will use your sign-in email, name, username, birthdate, gender, address, contact number and avatar to manage your account and support rehabilitation within this system. Your connected therapist can view these details to understand your patient profile and provide care. Your rehabilitation records are used for session tracking and progress review. We use these data only for these system purposes. You can edit your profile, request a copy or deletion of your data in Profile, and contact your care provider about your consent. Requests require review; they do not immediately erase existing care records. This agreement is separate from consent to record movement summaries. Privacy agreement version: system-purpose-v1.
I have read this agreement and consent to the use of my data for these system purposes.
